claim_boundary: This ledger compares current repository and isolated staging-like evidence with external product benchmarks. It does not establish production deployment or PRODUCTION_PROVEN status.

capabilities.capability: Temporary or recovery-password lifecycle
capabilities.rationale: Oteryn uses expiring single-use password-reset tokens rather than issuing a temporary plaintext password, and password reset/change revokes existing sessions.

capabilities.capability: Recovery key purchase, issue, use and revocation
capabilities.rationale: Oteryn issues one high-assurance recovery key, displays it once, stores only a keyed verifier and supports rotation, revocation, single use and replay denial without requiring a purchase product.

capabilities.capability: Confirmed email change with cooldown and recovery
capabilities.rationale: The account-security lifecycle requires new-address confirmation, provides old-address cancellation or recovery, enforces expiry and cooldown, rejects replay and revokes existing web sessions and game authorizations.

oteryn_evidence.marker: @portal-account account security lifecycle covers sessions, privacy, verified email recovery, recovery keys and termination grace

capabilities.capability: Active-session inventory and targeted remote revocation
capabilities.rationale: Users can inspect bounded current and remote registered-session summaries, revoke one owned session, revoke all other sessions or revoke the current session; foreign and stale identifiers fail closed.

capabilities.capability: Connected-account inventory and safe unlink or rebind
capabilities.rationale: Oteryn deliberately keeps the ready Platform-to-Canary binding immutable. Self-service unlink, rebind, transfer or legacy claim is not a safe product operation without a separately reviewed cross-repository mutation contract.

capabilities.capability: Authenticator-app and email-code second-factor management
capabilities.rationale: TOTP enrollment, challenge, disable and single-use recovery codes are complete. Email-code MFA is explicitly not adopted because email already serves as the recovery channel and would not provide the intended independent second-factor assurance.

capabilities.capability: Account badges, loyalty and status presentation
capabilities.rationale: No code-owned account badge or loyalty/status model is delivered; Oteryn must first define which statuses have product meaning.

capabilities.capability: Account-level public-profile privacy controls
capabilities.rationale: The account-security surface provides private-by-default controls for public account association and public status visibility, persisted and audited server-side.

oteryn_evidence.marker: Account privacy settings have been updated.

capabilities.capability: Account termination with grace period, cancellation and audit
capabilities.rationale: Platform account termination requires explicit confirmation, applies dependency guards, schedules a bounded grace period, supports cancellation and finalizes idempotently while preserving Canary-owned account and character data.

capabilities.capability: Owner-editable public character information or comment
capabilities.rationale: The public character view is read-only and no authorized owner-edit route exists.

capabilities.capability: Character-level public visibility and account-association controls
capabilities.rationale: Oteryn has no owner-controlled hidden character fields; account-level defaults now exist but character-specific policy and presentation remain absent.

capabilities.capability: Selectable publicly displayed achievements
capabilities.rationale: No structured achievement read model or owner selection exists in the current public profile.

capabilities.capability: Complete public character profile
capabilities.rationale: Current detail exposes only active name, level, vocation and guild name; deaths, house, achievements, comment and privacy-aware account information are absent.

capabilities.capability: Character deletion, grace period and restore lifecycle
capabilities.rationale: Character deletion and restoration are explicitly not delivered and require a new cross-repository mutation contract.

capabilities.capability: Character rename with reservation, cooldown and history
capabilities.rationale: Character rename is explicitly not delivered and needs consistency across login, guild, Bazaar and public-data surfaces.

capabilities.capability: Character or world transfer service
capabilities.rationale: Bazaar transfers account ownership inside the current server boundary, but no world/channel transfer product exists.

capabilities.capability: Main-character selection
capabilities.rationale: Oteryn does not currently use a main-character concept; adoption depends on community/profile product policy.

capabilities.capability: Guild, house and account linkage with visibility rules
capabilities.rationale: Guild name and membership are visible, but house and privacy-aware account association are not represented and guild management is absent.

capabilities.capability: Premium or VIP purchase and expiry
capabilities.rationale: No customer premium/VIP product, entitlement or expiry lifecycle exists.

capabilities.capability: Coin purchase, balance and entitlement delivery
capabilities.rationale: The Platform wallet and Bazaar reservations are implemented, but customers cannot purchase coins and no provider-delivery lifecycle exists.

capabilities.capability: Game-code or voucher redemption
capabilities.rationale: No signed or single-use redemption-code model and no customer redemption surface exists.

capabilities.capability: Purchased products ready to use
capabilities.rationale: There is no purchased-product queue, activation state or entitlement-consumption workflow.

capabilities.capability: Payment, store, coin, service and voucher histories
capabilities.rationale: Bazaar auction and wallet-ledger history exist, but there are no customer payment, store, service or voucher histories.

capabilities.capability: Provider checkout, webhook verification, refunds and chargebacks
capabilities.rationale: No payment provider is integrated; this complete security lifecycle is mandatory before any commercial activation.

capabilities.capability: Authenticated support-ticket lifecycle
capabilities.rationale: Oteryn publishes support content but has no ticket creation, reply, status or closure workflow.

capabilities.capability: User report history and pending-report limits
capabilities.rationale: The report-a-bug page is informational CMS content; there is no authenticated report queue, history or pending limit.

capabilities.capability: Punishment and rule-violation history
capabilities.rationale: No account-visible enforcement record, acknowledgement or appeal state exists.

capabilities.capability: Ticket, report and enforcement notifications
capabilities.rationale: No notification state exists because the underlying support and enforcement lifecycles are absent.

capabilities.capability: Character search and detail completeness
capabilities.rationale: Name search and a basic active-character detail are delivered, but the read model is not benchmark-complete.

capabilities.capability: Guild directory, detail and administration
capabilities.rationale: Read-only guild detail and members are delivered, but no directory/search or authorized guild-management workflow exists.

capabilities.capability: Highscores categories and filters
capabilities.rationale: Only level highscores sorted by level and name are implemented; category, vocation and world/channel filters are absent.

capabilities.capability: Latest deaths, transfers and kill statistics
capabilities.rationale: No delivered public routes or acceptance surfaces expose deaths, transfer history or kill statistics.

capabilities.capability: Community polls
capabilities.rationale: No poll model or public/admin lifecycle is delivered; this is optional for the initial Oteryn release.

capabilities.capability: Public bans or punishment information
capabilities.rationale: No public enforcement view exists; any future delivery requires explicit privacy and moderation policy.

capabilities.capability: Character Bazaar public and authenticated lifecycle
capabilities.rationale: PR #270 delivered public discovery, immutable snapshots, watch/list/bid/buy/history, wallet reservation, escrow settlement and administrator recovery.

oteryn_evidence.marker: @portal-marketplace-public catalogue detail filters localization responsive layout and accessibility

capabilities.capability: Online-player and server/channel status
capabilities.rationale: Read-only online players and configured server/channel runtime states include empty, unavailable and restoration coverage.

capabilities.capability: Server-backed creatures, items, equipment and loot catalogues
capabilities.rationale: The Wiki supports editorial categories/articles but no authoritative server-backed creature/item/loot entities or availability snapshot.

capabilities.capability: Structured spells, quests, NPCs and achievements
capabilities.rationale: Some reviewed editorial launch articles may discuss these subjects, but no complete structured server-backed catalogues exist.

capabilities.capability: Maps and interactive maps
capabilities.rationale: No map or interactive-map surface is delivered; it is valuable but not required for the initial portal launch.

capabilities.capability: Hunting-place guides and calculators
capabilities.rationale: No structured hunting-place or calculation tools exist; these should follow authoritative item/creature/player-data foundations.

capabilities.capability: Battle pass, equipment presets, Huntfinder and linked tasks
capabilities.rationale: These server-specific engagement and discovery tools are optional differentiators and require separate product contracts.

capabilities.capability: World-transfer documentation
capabilities.rationale: Documentation is premature until Oteryn defines and implements a supported transfer service and operational contract.

capabilities.capability: Server-specific systems, items and annual events
capabilities.rationale: The Wiki and Events modules can publish reviewed localized content, but there is no complete versioned catalogue tied to authoritative Oteryn server availability.
